title: Friendly Orange Cat — Everyday Reactions

clips.label: Idle
clips.prompt: Six-frame 2-second looping idle: frame 1 is the resting front-facing pose; the cat gently breathes with a small chest rise and fall, makes one natural blink, and returns exactly to frame 1. Move the body only; keep the face region stable and leave facial features to the selected expression.

clips.label: Wave
clips.prompt: Six-frame 2-second looping friendly wave: the cat remains front-facing while one raised forepaw makes a clear side-to-side greeting wave, with a slight shoulder shift and gentle body breathing; return to the resting pose at frame 1. Move the body only; keep the face region stable and leave facial features to the selected expression.

clips.label: Bounce
clips.prompt: Six-frame 2-second looping buoyant bounce: the cat compresses slightly, springs upward, reaches a small peak, and settles back into the resting stance, with paws and tail following naturally. Keep the face region stable and front-facing; move the body only and leave facial features to the selected expression.

clips.label: Sway
clips.prompt: Six-frame 2-second looping gentle side-to-side sway: the cat leans its whole body slightly left, passes through center, leans slightly right, and returns to the resting pose, with the tail counterbalancing. Keep the face region stable and facing forward; move the body only and leave facial features to the selected expression.

clips.label: Wiggle
clips.prompt: Six-frame 2-second looping playful wiggle: the cat makes two small rhythmic torso and tail wiggles while keeping its feet grounded and returning to the resting stance. Keep the face region stable and front-facing; move the body only and leave facial features to the selected expression.

clips.label: Hop
clips.prompt: Six-frame 2-second looping single cheerful hop: the cat bends, lifts its body and one paw in a compact hop, lands softly, and returns to frame 1. Keep the face region stable and front-facing; move the body only and leave facial features to the selected expression.

clips.label: Spin
clips.prompt: Six-frame 2-second looping playful partial body twist: the cat makes a small left-right body twist as if beginning a spin, with torso, paws, and tail turning while the face region remains clearly visible and facing forward throughout; return to the resting pose. Move the body only and leave facial features to the selected expression.

clips.label: Dance
clips.prompt: Six-frame 2-second looping upbeat dance: the cat alternates a tiny shoulder shimmy, one lifted paw, a small step-like weight shift, and a cheerful tail flourish, returning to the front-facing resting pose at frame 1. Keep the face region stable and visible; move the body only and leave facial features to the selected expression.
